title: Descent of the antipode translation map
statement: Let k be a field, H a commutative Hopf k-algebra, and K a k-subalgebra satisfying Δ_H(t)∈span_k{a⊗_k b:a,b∈K} and S_H(t)∈K for every t∈K. Let B be a commutative k-bialgebra and q:H→B a surjective bialgebra homomorphism with ker(q)=Ideal.span{x∈H:x∈K and ε_H(x)=0}. Give H its K-algebra structure by inclusion. Put T=H⊗_K H and let C:H⊗_k H→T be the canonical k-algebra homomorphism sending a⊗_k b to a⊗_K b. There exists a k-algebra homomorphism σ:B→T such that σ(q(b))=C((S_H⊗id_H)Δ_H(b)) for every b∈H.
lean_statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {H : Type*} [CommRing H] [HopfAlgebra k H] (K : Subalgebra k H) (hΔ : ∀ x ∈ K, Coalgebra.comul (R := k) x ∈ Submodule.span k {t : TensorProduct k H H | ∃ a ∈ K, ∃ b ∈ K, t = TensorProduct.tmul k a b}) (hS : ∀ x ∈ K, HopfAlgebra.antipode k x ∈ K) {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Bialgebra k B] (q : BialgHom k H B) (hq : Function.Surjective q) (hker : RingHom.ker (q : H →+* B) = Ideal.span {x : H | x ∈ K ∧ Coalgebra.counit (R := k) x = 0}), ∃ σ : B →ₐ[k] (TensorProduct K H H), ∀ b : H, σ (q b) = Algebra.TensorProduct.mapOfCompatibleSMul K k k H H (TensorProduct.map (HopfAlgebra.antipode k) (LinearMap.id : H →ₗ[k] H) (Coalgebra.comul (R := k) b))
